plain.verdict: We could only check the price behaviour for this one — its financial statements aren't published by our data source. On price alone, it's behaving strongly.

plan.entry_note: wait for a close above 1,179 (strength 55/100) on above-average volume — do not front-run it
plan.invalidation: A daily CLOSE below 1,086.96 kills this plan — exit without negotiation. Douglas: the market doesn't know you're in a trade; the stop is the only opinion that matters.
plan.principles: Rules encoded from Weinstein (stage analysis), Minervini (trend template, 8% max risk), O'Neil (volume confirmation), Livermore (pivot entries), Elder (ATR stops), Tharp (expectancy & sizing), Douglas (pre-committed exits). No engine predicts price — the edge is taking only asymmetric bets and cutting the wrong ones fast.
why: Stage 2 advance — price above a rising 200-DMA (Weinstein: the only stage worth buying)
Minervini trend template: price above the 50-DMA (≈1,089) which is above the 200-DMA
Volume on up-days is 60000000.0× volume on down-days over 60 sessions — accumulation footprint (O'Neil: institutions can't hide)
O'Neil: the breakout is only valid on volume ≥ 1.5× average — a quiet breakout usually fails
No overhead resistance after the breakout — measured-move targets used (2R and 3R)

profile.description: Northern Union Bank Limited provides banking products and services to individuals, commercial enterprises, corporates, public bodies and institutional customers in India and internationally. It operates through Treasury, Corporate and Wholesale Banking, Retail Banking, and Other Banking Business segments. The company accepts savings, current and term deposits and offers home, personal, auto, education and gold loans, along with loans against securities and property. It also provides working capital finance, project and structured finance, cash management, trade finance and supply chain finance, as well as life and general insurance, mutual funds, cards and merchant payment services through its subsidiaries. The bank serves its customers through a network of branches, ATMs and digital channels.
profile.source: Business description as published by the data provider

checks.explain: Moving averages smooth price into a trend line. Price above rising averages, with short averages above long ones, is the classic definition of an uptrend.
checks.formula: 6 pts each: P>EMA20, P>EMA50, P>EMA200, EMA20>EMA50, EMA50>EMA200
checks.name: Trend structure

checks.explain: The Hull Moving Average reacts faster than a normal average with less lag. Its slope is a quick read on short-term direction.
checks.formula: 10 pts if HMA(21) today > HMA(21) yesterday
checks.name: Hull MA direction

checks.explain: RSI measures the speed of recent gains vs losses on a 0–100 scale. 50–70 is strength without overheating; above ~78 the move is often exhausted.
checks.name: RSI(14) regime

checks.explain: MACD compares a fast and slow average of price. Above its signal line with a growing gap means momentum is building, not fading.
checks.formula: 7 pts: MACD above signal · 8 pts: histogram expanding
checks.name: MACD momentum

checks.explain: ADX measures how strongly price is trending (in either direction). Below 20 means choppy, directionless trade — signals are less reliable there.
checks.name: ADX trend strength

checks.explain: Supertrend draws a volatility-adjusted band under (or over) price. Which side price sits on is a simple trend-following regime filter.
checks.formula: 10 pts if close is above the Supertrend(10, 3×ATR) band
checks.name: Supertrend

checks.explain: Volume is how many shares changed hands. Rising average volume means more people are participating — a price move backed by growing volume is more convincing than one on thin trade.
checks.name: Volume trend

checks.explain: If more shares trade on rising days than falling days, buyers are being more aggressive than sellers — that's accumulation. The reverse is distribution, where holders are quietly exiting.
checks.name: Accumulation vs distribution
checks.value: Up-day volume 19,000,000 vs down-day volume 0 = 2.0× (20 sessions)

checks.explain: On-Balance Volume adds volume on up days and subtracts it on down days, building a running total. When OBV rises alongside price, the trend has real buying behind it. When price rises but OBV doesn't, the move is hollow.
checks.formula: 5 pts if OBV today is above OBV 30 sessions ago
checks.name: On-Balance Volume

checks.explain: Bollinger Bands sit two standard deviations either side of a 20-day average. %B tells you where price sits inside that channel: above 0.5 is the strong half, above 1.0 means price has pushed outside the band, which is powerful but often short-lived.
checks.name: Bollinger position

checks.explain: When Bollinger bands narrow, volatility has compressed and price is coiling — these periods often precede large directional moves. The squeeze doesn't tell you the direction, only that energy is building, which is exactly why it is shown here and left out of the score.
checks.formula: Not scored — a squeeze has no direction, so it earns no points either way
checks.name: Volatility squeeze
checks.value: Bandwidth at the 48.0th percentile of 6 months

checks.explain: Stocks near 52-week highs statistically continue outperforming (momentum effect); stocks in the bottom of their range are fighting overhead supply.
checks.formula: 10 pts: top quartile · 6: upper half · 3: 30–50% · 0: bottom 30%
checks.name: 52-week range position
